messages:
violet: hitting a baffling reshape crash in the quickstart demo (embeddings -> rerank). Some candidate vectors are 2047 floats, others 2048. sampleapp blows up when building Float32Array.

rashid: which quickstart image & SDKs? any raw bodies from REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1?

violet: quickstart: redwood/quickstart:canary, java-sdk v0.4.2, but I tried python and got same issue. model=openembed-xl-2026-01. quick dump shows mixed lengths and mixed field names: some candidates have `vector`, some `embedding`.

sdk-java: thanks. quick question: are you using the batching helper utility in the sampleapp (`batchingHelper`) or passing candidates directly?

violet: sampleapp uses `batchingHelper.packCandidates(cands)` before client.rerank. I noticed `packCandidates` documents `dims` default=2048 but it doesn't validate candidate lengths. If a candidate was produced by an older embed model that is 2047 we silently accept it and then the SDK tries to reshape into dims.

rashid: that sounds like two bugs: 1) sampleapp batching helper assumes a dims value without validating, 2) SDK parsing allowed mixed `vector`/`embedding` fields and autobatcher concat could drop a float if a retry happened mid-stream.

sdk-python: we've seen this class before. short-term fixes: a) batching helper should infer dims from the first candidate and assert all match, b) SDKs should normalize `embedding`/`vector` fields and assert equal lengths before typedarray allocation, c) retry semantics must avoid combining partial bodies.

violet: workaround I used: in sampleapp change to `const packed = batchingHelper.packCandidates(cands,{validate:true});` and inlined check: `if (!cands.every(c=>c.embedding?.length===expected)) throw new Error('inconsistent embedding lengths')`. stopped the crash.

sdk-js: we'll add a normalization shim: inside the rerank client parse -> `const vec = candidate.embedding || candidate.vector;` and a length-map check `const lens = candidates.map(c=>vec(c).length); if (new Set(lens).size>1) throw new Error(...)` with request-id logged. Also adding a small metric to track how often mixed lengths appear.

sdk-java: we'll mirror the check in Java and add a warning in the sampleapp quickstart to pin SDKs or enable validation.

ciara-bot: incident created: INC-2026-355 embed-rerank-dims-and-batching (priority: low)

rashid: ops note: please capture the x-request-id for any failing run so we can trace gateway logs. also check auth logs 11: I saw a few transient 401s in the timeframe which likely triggered a retry that overlapped streaming.

violet: I have the request-id: rwd-req-2026-xy99 and attached sanitized dump to internal snapshot. The 401s line up with the first bad run.

sdk-python: immediate plan: hotfix the batchingHelper default to validate dims, add assert in py-sdk v0.9.2 to normalize fields and error early, and add a retry-safety change so we don't stitch partial bodies. sampleapp will be updated to include validate flag in quickstart.

sdk-js: follow-up: will add an explicit example in README showing how to call the rerank helper safely and a troubleshooting bullet: "If you get embedding length mismatch during onboarding: set REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1, disable autobatch, or enable batching helper validation."

rashid: thanks — these onboarding crashes are high friction for new devs. please prioritize the sampleapp note.

violet: workaround resolved my demo for now. will re-run after the hotfix and post results here. :thumbsup:
